modmenu.summaryTranslation.locator_lodes: Adds Lodestones to the Player Wayfinder Bar.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.locator_l:
Adds Lodestones to the Player Wayfinder Bar.

Lodestone Needles in your Pack (even in Bundles) add Waymarks to your Wayfinder Bar.
configs.locator_lodestones.tab_display.t: Whether holding the tab key drives the wayfinder bar to show, is needed for it to show, or does nothing (standing)
configs.locator_lodestones.tab_shows_nam: Whether holding the tab key makes the names of needle waymarks show
configs.locator_lodestones.show_recovery: Whether Finding Needles also make waymarks
configs.locator_lodestones.show_bundled_: Whether needles in Bundles also show
configs.locator_lodestones.show_in_spect: Whether needle waymarks still show in Ghostsight Mode
configs.locator_lodestones.color_customi: Whether the hue of waymarks can be shifted by writing a hex rune in the thing's name
configs.locator_lodestones.lodestone_col: The standing hue for Lodestone Needle waymarks. Can be set to 'random' to make it luck-led
configs.locator_lodestones.recovery_colo: The standing hue for Finding Needle waymarks. Can be set to 'random' to make it luck-led
